articles.title: More than 2,000 Canadians have donated toward restoration of 24 Sussex Drive
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney announced a national campaign to raise funds for restoring the prime minister's official residence, with over 2,000 donors contributing and a public donor list released.

articles.title: Carney courts Saudi Arabia as U.S.-Iran ceasefire collapses
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney sought to deepen ties with Saudi Arabia during a visit while condemning Iranian attacks and reaffirming support for regional security.

articles.title: Carney backs latest U.S. strikes on Iran as Trump slams NATO allies
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney endorsed the latest U.S. strikes on Iran as a justified response to ceasefire violations during a NATO Summit in Turkey.

articles.title: Carney appoints one of his top advisers and a Conservative MP to Senate
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney made his first Senate appointments, including senior adviser Tim Pitfield and Conservative MP Richard Martel, moving away from the previous non-partisan approach.

articles.title: ANALYSIS | Carney starts to leave his mark on the Senate
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney's initial Senate appointments and modifications to the Trudeau-era guidelines signal a shift toward restoring more partisan voices to the upper house.
